content:
感谢各位守密人的支持！《忘却前夜》新OST已发布，欢迎收听、下载及分享。
如果有基于OST的二次创作，也欢迎分享给我们！二创请遵照同人规则，OST内容请勿商用。

**忘却前夜OST丨蚀灭·萝坦EP·征伐永不止歇**
彼时我仍是最低贱的童仆，曾亲眼见证过一场堪称残酷的征途。
那位传奇的主人，力量铸就了她的骨血，热血沸腾成了不灭之火，火光又点燃了她的眼睛——
请替我继续铭记这段往事，我的孩子。……她最终获胜，并征服了星空。

✦ 曲：F.R.K. / B.I.A.V. Studio
✦ 企划：B.I.A.V. Studio

——✦——✦—— ✦✦✦ ——✦——✦——

Thank you for your support!

Morimens new OST was released today. Welcome everyone to listen, download and share.
If you have secondary creations based on the OST, please also share them with us!
 (Please follow the rules of the fandom for secondary creations, and do not use the OST content for commercial purposes)

**Morimens OST┊Lotan: Cetarchon EP: Conquest Never Rests**
Back when I was still the lowliest of servants, I once bore witness to a campaign of utter cruelty.
That legendary master—power forged her very flesh and bone, her seething blood became an undying flame, and that firelight in turn set her eyes ablaze—
Keep this memory alive for me, my child... In the end, she triumphed, and conquered the sea of stars.

✦ Composer: F.R.K. / B.I.A.V. Studio
✦ Planning: B.I.A.V. Studio
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：蚀灭·萝坦EP·征伐永不止歇┊Morimens OST: Lotan: Cetarchon EP: Conquest Never Rests

content:
**01. 淌过猩红-Wading the Crimson**
死者摔落在将死者后，强者拜服于更强者前。
冰冷寒厉的刃上，只会显出站立着的影子。

The dead tumble behind the dying, and the strong kneel before the stronger.
Upon the cold, ruthless blade, only the standing silhouette remains.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：蚀灭·萝坦EP·征伐永不止歇┊Morimens OST: Lotan: Cetarchon EP: Conquest Never Rests

content:
**02. 呢喃之蛇-Whispering Serpent**
通往胜利的道途上，总有那么一些不够光彩的手段。
On the road to victory, there are always methods less than glorious.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：蚀灭·萝坦EP·征伐永不止歇┊Morimens OST: Lotan: Cetarchon EP: Conquest Never Rests

content:
**03. 权欲豢养的亡灵-Apparitions of Desire**
面包与马戏，世人只会为这二者雀跃不已。
祂欣赏着，祂不在乎。
她亲历着，她不在乎。

Panem et circenses—the masses rejoice at nothing else.
It watches, yet It cares not.
She lives it, yet shecares not.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：蚀灭·萝坦EP·征伐永不止歇┊Morimens OST: Lotan: Cetarchon EP: Conquest Never Rests

content:
**04. 獠牙相向-Fangs Bared**
一片荒芜之上，怒目相瞪的野兽徘徊着，它们都在寻找时机，一个把利齿刺穿脖颈，彻底将对方撕碎的时机。

Upon the desolate waste, glaring beasts prowl.
Each awaits the moment to sink its fangs deep into the throat, and tear the other to shreds.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：蚀灭·萝坦EP·征伐永不止歇┊Morimens OST: Lotan: Cetarchon EP: Conquest Never Rests

content:
**05. 垂死鲸歌-Leviathan's Dying Song**
绳子会压下它的舌头，绳索能穿过它的鼻子，鱼钩将刺破它的腮骨。
于是，骄傲的王也陨落，天空也陨落。

A rope shall tie down its tongue, a cord shall pass through its nose, and a hook shall pierce its jaw.
And so the proud king falls, and so the sky falls too.
thread_title: 忘却前夜OST：蚀灭·萝坦EP·征伐永不止歇┊Morimens OST: Lotan: Cetarchon EP: Conquest Never Rests

content:
**06. 戮天的狂舞-Star-Slaying Frenzy**
收起你那无聊的王冠，我从未将它放在眼里。拔刀吧，世界正为鲜血而癫狂！
如此，只为如此——
弑杀吧！蚀啮吧！灭亡吧！

Put away your tedious crown; I never gave it a second glance. Draw your blade—the world is mad for blood!
For this, and for this alone—
Slay! Devour! Perish!
